- .claude/commands/fix-claude-pr.md:46 | severity=high | confidence=[5]

  PROBLEM: The conflict PushNotification template hardcodes `<default>` instead of using `<source>`.
  WHY: During a project-branch or PR-base merge conflict, the operator receives a notification naming the wrong conflict source, which misdirects investigation.
- workflow-templates/.claude/commands/fix-claude-pr.md:46 | severity=high | confidence=[5]

  WHY: A project-branch or base-merge conflict emits a notification naming the wrong source, misdirecting the operator.
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:190 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The "Any other base" case does not explicitly specify how to record remaining default-branch guard drift when both drift checks exit non-zero.
  WHY: Merging only the PR base may leave default-branch guard changes absent without recording a `claude_assets=stale` note, leaving the operator unaware that the environment is inconsistent.
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:189 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The reference to "the procedure's step 2 (Sync the project branch)" is ambiguous inside the Claude-asset sync section.
  WHY: An unattended session may look for the merge command in the drift check instead of the Procedure section and fail to find it, causing the sync to fail.
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:182-194 (step 2/3 routing) | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The project-branch verification path can fail on fetch with no paths, yet the fixer stop assumes paths exist.
  WHY: A transient fetch failure produces an error line instead of paths; the blocker comment becomes incomplete and the session may loop or ask unnecessarily.
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:189 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The blocker-evidence diff assumes `origin/<project branch>` was fetched successfully.
  WHY: If the fetch fails, the diff fails instead of listing the diverging paths, leaving the operator without structured evidence.
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md and fix-claude-pr.md: Lines 181, 183, 188; Line 46 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The commands use inconsistent placeholder names, `<base>` and `<base ref>`, for the same PR-base-ref concept.
  WHY: Copying prose between files can leave a placeholder that references a nonexistent remote ref, leading to check failures.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
